serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
As I walk through less wealthy parts of the city I hear a loud screech.
Mysterious pink man: {{punch=0.5,0.5}}REEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE!
A weird pink man appears.
I try to walk past him unnoticed.
Mysterious pink man: HEY YOU!
Mission failed.
You: What?
Mysterious pink man: You look like someone in need of money...
You: I guess.
Mysterious pink man: I know a way...
Is he insane?
You: What? Are you crazy?
Mysterious pink man: Call me whatever you want. Bogd*****s are onto me, so I can't tell you my real name.
You: Okay. What do you want then?
Mysterious pink man: Go to a website. "stonks.ic". If you are lucky... or smart you can make a fortune there.
Mysterious pink man: I did.
That sounds like a scam.
You: So... Are you rich?
Mysterious pink man: No, I lost it all. That's why I'm pink.
He's definitely crazy. Let's leave him alone.
You: I have to go.
I might check out that website later though.
